content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Remuneration/honorarium paid as per the norms of Mission Vatsalya under the W&CD Department, Government of Odisha. Engagement initially for a period of Eleven months Tenure may be extended or curtailed by the Children Home Management Committee based on performance review Purely temporary, contractual, time bound and coterminous with the scheme or depending on satisfactory performance, whichever is earlier Continuance decided by the management based on annual performance appraisal Panel valid for 1 year from the date of finalization

content_sections.heading: How Will DCPU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Career Marking on weighted marks (Secondary 10, Higher Secondary 15, Graduation 25, Post-Graduation 30, professional course/training related to child rights or MPhil/PhD 10, Work Experience 10) Merit list on weighted percentage of marks Verification of certificates of highest-scoring candidates before appointment order Recruitment on the basis of Career Marking only, per weightage table Merit list drawn on weighted percentage of marks in 6 categories Tie: candidate with experience of working in Child Right preferred Selection Committee recommends 5 candidates per position in order of preference Highest scorers called for verification of certificates before appointment order Decision of Chairperson of District Level Selection Committee is final

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopy of Secondary, HSC, Graduation, Post Graduation or other professional qualification certificate and mark sheet One recent self-attested colour photograph (3.5x4 size) affixed to the application form Certificate of experience issued from previous employer Self-declaration regarding non-involvement in any criminal activities especially child related offences Copy of PVR of the candidate

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DCPU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 1 Superintendent, 1 Counselor, 1 Probation Officer/Case Worker/Child Welfare Officer, 1 House father, 1 Educator, 1 Art & Craft-cum-Music Teacher and 3 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DCPU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 25 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 45 years (as on the first day of the year of the publication of recruitment notice).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 33,100 for Superintendent, 23,170 for Counselor, 23,170 for Probation Officer/Case Worker/Child Welfare Officer, 14,564 for House father, 10,000 for Educator.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Varies by post: Master's Degree / Post Graduate (Superintendent, Counselor, Probation Officer), Graduate in any discipline (House father), B.S.C (Educator), Bachelor in Fine Art, B.A B.P.Ed, Under Matric (Cook), 8th-10th (Helper). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India. Must have good moral character. Must speak, read and write Odia and have passed the prescribed Odia language test or examination.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Career Marking on weighted marks (Secondary 10, Higher Secondary 15, Graduation 25, Post-Graduation 30, professional course/training related to child rights or MPhil/PhD 10, Work Experience 10). Merit list on weighted percentage of marks. Verification of certificates of highest-scoring candidates before appointment order. Recruitment on the basis of Career Marking only, per weightage table.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement initially for a period of Eleven months. Tenure may be extended or curtailed by the Children Home Management Committee based on performance review. Purely temporary, contractual, time bound and coterminous with the scheme or depending on satisfactory performance, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Utkal Balashram (Child Care Institution), Kantabanji, Balangir.
